messages:
alex_sales: Quick sync — BridgePoint is ready to convert from POC to prod. Lina says they will sign a 12mo commit for Dedicated + Private deployment. Customer is asking for a 33% off list concession for an ARR of ~$150k. Can dealdesk + security weigh in? cc @maria_dealdesk @sam_se

lina_ae: FYI customer notes: needs SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, and private VPC + on-prem connector. Legal wants a standard 60-day SLA credit clause removed — they asked we accept a 30-day cap. They can start in Q2.

sam_se: Got it. Two quick Qs: 1) Any PHI/regulated data? 2) Which model family are they planning to use (redwood-curie / open-llama etc.) — that affects private package. Also need to know if they want upload storage in their VPC.

lina_ae: No PHI, primarily PII (hashed IDs). They plan to use the curated open models, mostly 7B variants. VPC + local storage required.

maria_dealdesk: Thanks. Need the commercial ask broken down and margin impact. Also include competitor comps if available and any logo/reference leverage. If we're giving >25% we need exec approval + a churn risk plan.

luke_fin: Quick calc from list: assume list = $18,000/mo (dedicated baseline) => annual list = 216k. 33% off -> customer pays ~145k/yr. Rough margin check: with dedicated reserved capacity and private deployment the unit cost is ~10-12k/mo; net gets tight.

```
pricing calc (rough):
 list_month = 18000
 list_annual = list_month * 12 = 216000
 33pct_off = list_annual * 0.67 = 144720
```

jon_runtime: Heads up from runtime side — Private + Dedicated for a single tenant 7B workload needs pinned GPUs for predictable latency. At 33% off on a 12mo, our reserved pool margin goes negative unless they take a multi-year commit or we charge an onboarding/infra premium. Suggest options: (A) 20% off + $10k one-time onboarding, (B) 25% off for 18mo, (C) 33% off only for 24mo with a min capacity commit.

alex_sales: Customer flexibility: they will not do 24mo, but might accept a $15k onboarding/attachment fee. They really want the sticker reduction though — arguing competitor X offered ~30% on comparable bundles.

maria_dealdesk: Proposed deal structure to present to customer: 1) 20% enterprise discount on list for 12mo + $12k onboarding + standard SLA language (no 30-day cap change), 2) 25% for 18mo + $8k onboarding, 3) 30% for 24mo + $0 onboarding (exec signoff required). Need your preference and whether legal can accept standard SLA.

lina_ae: Customer prefers 25% but will not do 18mo. They asked if we can front-load commitment (pay 12mo upfront) in exchange for 28% — is that something we can consider?

luke_fin: Upfront annual prepay helps cashflow and lowers risk. If they prepay 12mo, we could consider bumping to 28% instead of 25% (subject to accounting / revenue recognition).

sam_se: Security note: prepay doesn't change security requirements. We need SAML metadata, network prep, and SOC2 evidence before handoff. Can we get a Q/A timeline from ops?

ops_bot: @sam_se — private VPC provisioning lead time estimated 4-6 weeks once infra order is confirmed. Network checklist: VPN tunnel, SAML cert, allowed egress list. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-provisioning

maria_dealdesk: Action items: Alex — confirm whether customer will prepay 12mo for 28% ask and whether they can accept onboarding fee alternative. Alex, include competitor pricing screenshot + any logo/reference they offered. I'll escalate 28% prepay to finance/exec if you confirm.

alex_sales: Will confirm with BridgePoint this afternoon and share their legal contact + competitor screenshot. Thanks — will update here by EOD. :thumbsup:

lina_ae: Adding customer note — they want a shorter termination window for pilot rollback (30 days) but are ok with standard SLA if we push onboarding earlier.

maria_dealdesk: Perfect. If Alex confirms prepay + legal contact, I'll open an exec approval thread and loop finance.

alex_sales: Confirmed: customer is willing to prepay 12mo if we can do 28%. Sending legal contact now. Attaching pricing sheet: https://docs.redwood/pricing/bridgepoint-quote (internal)

maria_dealdesk: Received. Escalating for exec signoff now. Will report back w/in 24hrs. :raised_hands:
